therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: lipid profile normalization (TG reduction, HDL-C increase, LDL-C reduction)
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with mixed dyslipidemia or coronary heart disease with multiple abnormal lipid levels
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean percent change in triglycerides, HDL-C, and LDL-C from baseline to 12 weeks

results.effect_size: TG: ABT-335+atorvastatin 20mg -45.6%, ABT-335+atorvastatin 40mg -42.1%; HDL-C: +14.0% and +12.6%; LDL-C: -33.7% and -35.4%
results.target_engagement_evidence: Significant changes in TG, HDL-C, LDL-C, VLDL-C, non-HDL-C, Apo B consistent with PPARα agonism and statin activity
biomarker_changes: TG reduced -45.6% (ABT-335+atorva 20mg) and -42.1% (ABT-335+atorva 40mg) vs -16.5% and -23.2% for atorvastatin monotherapy
HDL-C increased +14.0% and +12.6% (combo) vs +6.3% and +5.3% (atorvastatin mono)
LDL-C reduced -33.7% and -35.4% (combo) vs -37.1% and -39.7% (atorvastatin mono)
VLDL-C reduced -48.3% and -53.5% (combo) vs -26.2% and -35.6% (atorvastatin mono)
Non-HDL-C reduced -40.8% and -42.5% (combo) vs -35.7% and -41.7% (atorvastatin mono)
Apo B reduced -37.0% and -37.1% (combo) vs -32.9% and -35.3% (atorvastatin mono)
hsCRP median change: -26.2% (combo 20mg) and -42.9% (combo 40mg) vs -29.6% and -30.3% (atorvastatin mono)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and distributed across arms; no clustering of serious events in combination arms
Cholecystitis and cholelithiasis each occurred in 1/110 subjects in ABT-335+40mg atorvastatin arm (consistent with known fibrate class effect)

dose_info.dose: ABT-335 135 mg; Atorvastatin 20 mg, 40 mg, or 80 mg

context.indication: Mixed dyslipidemia / coronary heart disease with multiple abnormal lipid levels
context.comparator: Atorvastatin monotherapy (20 mg, 40 mg, or 80 mg) and ABT-335 monotherapy

modulation_entries.hypothesis: ABT-335 (PPARα agonist) amplifies the lipid-lowering biology of atorvastatin by adding TG reduction and HDL-C elevation on top of statin-mediated LDL-C lowering, producing a broader dyslipidemia correction than either agent alone
modulation_entries.citation: ABT-335 + 20 mg Atorvastatin: TG -45.6% vs 20 mg Atorvastatin alone -16.5%; HDL-C +14.0% vs +6.3%; p<0.001 for TG comparison
